problem_analysis.root_cause: The dropdown menu in Emprestimos.js uses a custom createPortal implementation with a hardcoded MENU_HEIGHT of 150px. When the 4th option ('Prorrogar Empréstimo') is rendered, the actual menu height exceeds 150px. This causes the collision detection logic to fail (spaceBelow < MENU_HEIGHT evaluates to false when it shouldn't), pushing the menu off-screen or cutting it off.

technical_directives.primary_solution: Replace the custom manual portal dropdown with Shadcn UI's DropdownMenu component to let Radix UI handle dynamic height, viewport boundaries, and collision automatically.
instructions_to_main_agent: Import DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu'.
Remove the manual `menuAberto`, `menuPosition`, and `handleMenuClick` state and logic from Emprestimos.js.
Wrap the three-dots button with <DropdownMenu> and <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>.
Move the action buttons ('Editar Empréstimo', 'Ver Detalhes', etc.) inside <DropdownMenuContent> as <DropdownMenuItem> components.
Keep the conditional rendering for 'Prorrogar Empréstimo' inside the DropdownMenuContent.
Set `align="end"` on DropdownMenuContent to ensure proper horizontal positioning relative to the trigger.
Radix UI will automatically handle collision detection, preventing the menu from being cut off on both desktop and mobile.
Ensure all interactive items include a `data-testid` attribute for robust testing (e.g., `data-testid="btn-prorrogar-menu"`).

fallback_solution.condition: If migrating to Shadcn UI is strictly not desired (though highly recommended).
instructions: Calculate MENU_HEIGHT dynamically based on the number of options rendered: `let numItems = 3; if (emprestimo.metodo_calculo === 'apenas_juros' && (emprestimo.status === 'ativo' || emprestimo.status === 'inadimplente')) numItems = 4;`
Update the `showAbove` top offset to use the dynamic `MENU_HEIGHT` instead of the hardcoded 150.

accessibility_and_styling: Ensure the DropdownMenuContent has appropriate z-index (`z-50`).
Preserve the existing icons (Pencil, Eye, DollarSign) and specific styling (e.g., emerald green for 'Registrar Pagamento').
Maintain keyboard accessibility (Arrow keys, Esc to close) natively provided by Shadcn UI.
